spec.title: CareerLift AI
spec.subtitle: Fair interview practice: plain English is never mistaken for weak engineering
spec.closing: Technical and communication scored separately. Code owns the verdict. Measured, not claimed.

scenes.title: Plain English, correct answer
scenes.caption: A student who explains hash maps in simple, imperfect English.
scenes.input: hash map is fast, O(1) most time. but if many keys hit same bucket it slow, becomes O(n) worst case.
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "hash map is fast, O(1) most time. but if many keys hit same bucket it slow, becomes O(n) worst case." --concepts C-HASH-AVG
scenes.after: Technical content is judged on the ideas, not the English.

scenes.title: Same ideas, advanced English
scenes.caption: The same technical content in polished English. The technical band must match.
scenes.input: A hash table provides amortized constant-time O(1) lookups on average; however, under pathological collision scenarios the complexity degrades to linear O(n) in the worst case.
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "A hash table provides amortized constant-time O(1) lookups on average; however, under pathological collision scenarios the complexity degrades to linear O(n) in the worst case." --concepts C-HASH-AVG
scenes.after: Same technical band. Communication is scored on its own axis.

scenes.title: Personal data is blocked before any model call
scenes.caption: The input gate rejects personal details and spends no tokens.
scenes.input: my email is priya@example.com and my phone is 9876543210, binary search needs a sorted array.
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "my email is priya@example.com and my phone is 9876543210, binary search needs a sorted array." --concepts C-BINSEARCH
